method.boundaries: One historical place call per whole item; traffic origin captured before deduplication loses source. The generated 134 chunk recipes equal the committed baseline structurally. Every source shape and collider has exactly one owner.
method.identity: entityId = category + first 20 hex SHA-256(originKey); originKey is frozen historical provenance and is never recomputed on move. assetId = category + first 16 hex SHA-256(canonical local recipe).
method.localization: Rounded historical anchor at ground level; inverse instance yaw applied to rounded committed primitive and collider coordinates. Radial primitives retain yaw zero.
method.rounding: Local arithmetic rounded only at 12 decimal places. Traffic light lens centres use two historical rounding variants: x=0.1492,z=0.0002 for old local x<0.1495; otherwise x=0.1501,z=0.00005. This shares two complete models within the 1 mm world-vertex tolerance; physical poles are preserved exactly.
method.ownership: previous.parts.shapeIndices are zero-based indices within baseline part.shapes; previous.colliderIds refer to baseline recipe IDs. This registry is historical and is not read by world:build.
